name: Large
description: Mark exhaustion when inflicting harm with this weapon to inflict 1 additional harm.

name: Reach
description: When you engage in melee, mark wear on this weapon to inflict harm instead of trading harm; you cannot use this tag if your enemy’s weapon also has reach.

name: Barbed
description: When you catch someone with this weapon’s end, mark exhaustion to move to intimate range and grapple them as if you had rolled a 10+.

name: Poison
description: When you target a vulnerable foe, inflict exhaustion instead of injury; your target is poisoned until cured. While poisoned, each time they take a significant or strenuous action, inflict exhaustion. If they fall unconscious, inflict injury every 6 hours until they receive the cure or perish.

name: Entangling
description: When you target a vulnerable foe with this weapon, aim for the head or the feet. If the feet, then on a hit, instead of inflicting harm, your target becomes entangled and falls. They must take time to free themselves before moving. If the head, then on a hit, mark wear and inflict 2-injury.

name: Metal rim
description: When you absorb injury as wear on this shield in close combat, you may mark an additional wear to immediately strike back with the edge of the shield and inflict injury.

name: Scattered spike
description: When you throw out caltrops to cover a door, path, or small area, mark any amount of wear. Anyone who crosses the caltrops must either take time and pass cautiously, or mark injury for each wear you marked to cover the area.

name: Hidden
description: Mark exhaustion when being searched or examined to ensure this item goes unnoticed. Mark wear to attempt the blindside roguish feat if you don’t have it, or to take a 10+ to blindside if you do have it.

name: Heavy bludgeon
description: Mark exhaustion to ignore your enemy’s armor when you inflict harm.

name: Slow
description: When you engage in melee with this weapon, choose one fewer option. Mark wear to ignore this effect.

name: Iron bolts
description: This weapon inflicts 1 additional wear when its harm is absorbed by armor.

name: Hair trigger
description: Mark wear to target a vulnerable foe at close range instead of far.

name: Quick
description: Mark exhaustion to engage in melee with Finesse instead of Might.

name: Throwable
description: Mark exhaustion to target a vulnerable foe with this weapon at far range.

name: Akimbo
description: Mark exhaustion when wielding a dagger in each hand to inflict 1 additional injury.

name: Intriguing
description: Mark wear when you play this instrument to ask an audience member a question from figure someone out.

name: Soothing
description: Mark exhaustion when you play this instrument in a quiet moment to clear exhaustion from each of your listeners.

name: Blunted
description: This weapon inflicts exhaustion, not injury.

name: Versatile
description: When you move to or from a range this weapon can reach, mark wear to make a quick strike and inflict injury on any opponent in this weapon’s range.

name: Foxfolk steel
description: Ignore the first box of wear you mark on this item each session.

name: Healer’s kit
description: When you use these supplies to provide medical aid to someone (including yourself), mark wear to clear exhaustion from them, or mark 2-wear to clear injury from them.

name: Arrow-proof
description: Ignore the first hit dealing injury from arrows that you suffer in a scene.

name: Thick
description: When you mark wear on this shield to block a hit, you only ever mark 1-wear, even if you are blocking more harm from a single hit.

name: Heavy Draw Weight
description: When you target a vulnerable foe with this bow, mark exhaustion to inflict 1 additional injury.

name: Sharp
description: Mark wear when inflicting harm with this weapon to inflict 1 additional harm.

name: Iron Flanges
description: This weapon inflicts 1 additional wear when its harm is absorbed by armor.

name: Hilt Guard
description: When you parry with this weapon, you can mark wear instead of exhaustion.

name: Punch Through
description: Mark exhaustion when dealing harm at intimate range to ignore your enemy’s armor.

name: Short Limbs
description: Mark wear to fire a quick shot at far range.

name: Ceremonial
description: Choose an attached faction. While this item is displayed, treat yourself as having +1 Reputation with that faction, and -1 Reputation with other factions.

name: Expendable
description: When you throw this weapon, it is automatically destroyed.

name: Explosive
description: When this item is destroyed, it explodes and deals 3-injury to everyone in its range (close). It also starts fires and destroys structures.

name: Tricky
description: When you use this item to trick an NPC by distracting them at a distance, on a 7–9 mark wear to eliminate one option from the trick an NPC move before the NPC picks.

name: Unassuming
description: Until you harm an enemy, they will never deem you more of a threat than other vagabonds with arms and armor.

name: Notched
description: When you inflict wear on armor or another weapon, mark wear to inflict 2 additional wear.

name: Metal boss
description: When you engage in melee with an opponent, mark wear to inflict exhaustion in addition to all other harm.
